reviewed.normalized_description:
StructuredFundVault._recordCashflow(bytes32,IStructuredFundCashflows.Cashflow,uint256) (src/StructuredFundVault.sol) uses timestamp for comparisons
	Dangerous comparisons:
	- id == bytes32(0) || _cashflows[id].beneficiary != address(0) || payment.claimed || payment.evidenceHash == bytes32(0) || payment.periodStart >= payment.periodEnd || payment.periodEnd > block.timestamp || payment.periodStart < lastCashflowPeriodEnd[payment.beneficiary] || payment.withheld > payment.grossYield || payment.principal > principalOf[payment.beneficiary] || navRelease < payment.principal || navRelease > creditNAV || navRelease > payment.principal + payment.grossYield || payment.principal + payment.grossYield == 0 (src/StructuredFundVault.sol)
reviewed.rationale: Closed reporting interval check only. No entropy, pricing or per-second accrual uses timestamp. Boundary skew remains an operational assumption.
